relations.text: BoxはGoogle Cloud Marketplaceで提供されるようになった
relations.text_en: Box became available on Google Cloud Marketplace

source.label: Box 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Announced that Box is now available on Google Cloud Marketplace, making it even easier for customers using Google Cloud infrastructure to purchase Box.

relations.text: Boxの年次報告が、競合としてGoogle(Drive)を挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor (Google Drive) in Box's annual report

source.label: Box 10-K
source.quote: In the enterprise file sync and share market, our primary competitors include, but are not limited to, Microsoft (OneDrive), Google (Drive) and, to a lesser extent, Dropbox.

relations.text: BoxはMicrosoftのAzure OpenAIとの提携を発表している
relations.text_en: Box has announced a partnership with Microsoft's Azure OpenAI

source.label: Box 10-K
source.quote: For example, Box has announced partnerships with Microsoft’s Azure OpenAI, Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, and Anthropic’s Claude and Amazon Titan via Amazon Bedrock.

relations.text: BoxはAWSとの戦略提携を拡大し、Amazon Bedrock経由の基盤モデルをBox AIで使えるようにした
relations.text_en: Box expanded its strategic partnership with AWS so customers can use foundation models in Box AI through Amazon Bedrock

source.label: Box 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Expanded its strategic partnership with Amazon Web Services (AWS), allowing customers to access foundation models directly in Box AI using Amazon Bedrock, starting with Anthropic’s Claude and Amazon Titan.

relations.text: BoxはAmazon Bedrock経由でAnthropicのClaudeを使う提携を発表している
relations.text_en: Box has announced a partnership involving Anthropic's Claude via Amazon Bedrock

source.label: Box 10-K
source.quote: For example, Box has announced partnerships with Microsoft’s Azure OpenAI, Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, and Anthropic’s Claude and Amazon Titan via Amazon Bedrock.

relations.text: BoxとChatGPTの連携が、Boxの全顧客に提供開始された
relations.text_en: The Box integration with ChatGPT is generally available for all Box customers

source.label: Box — ChatGPT enterprise-content integration, September 10, 2026
source.quote: The Box integration with ChatGPT is generally available today for all Box customers, with OpenAI rolling out access to users of ChatGPT’s paid tiers over the next few days.

relations.text: BoxはNVIDIA NIMとBox AIの協業を発表した

source.label: Box 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Announced a collaboration between NVIDIA NIM and Box AI to help provide businesses with a reliable and flexible platform for supercharging production AI.
